body:
Menus, dialogs, Settings and the phone menus now arrive in finer layers, in 9938602 and running in the existing HTTPS app. Fields and rows follow the dialog block that holds them, every menu item enters on its own, the navigation menu no longer fades in as one block, an opened disclosure reveals its content softly and rows that arrive later fade in.

Native system lists, such as the project and folder choosers, cannot take an entrance. Evidence: progress/2026-10-06-inner-layers.md.

metadata.summary: Layers inside menus, dialogs and disclosures
